newsitem.title: NIGER: Libya's Gaddafi leaves Niger for Nigeria.
newsitem.headline: Libya's Gaddafi leaves Niger for Nigeria.

text.p: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on Friday left the impoverished West African state of Niger to wind up his West African tour in Nigeria, officials said.
Gaddafi apparently defied a U.N. ban on flights from his country when he arrived in the Niger capital Niamey by plane on Thursday.
The ban was imposed for Libya's failure to extradite two agents linked to the bombing of the Pan Am flight over Lockerbie in 1988 and four agents linked to the 1989 bombing of a French airliner.

In Washington, a State Department spokesman said the United States was investigating reports that the embargo had been broken and that if it had been, the matter would be pursued in the U.N. Security Council and sanctions committee. A U.S. official said military action was not being considered.
Gaddafi's last trip abroad was by land to Tunisia in October 1996. He violated the ban when a Libyan-registered plane flew him to Cairo and back to attend an Arab summit in June 1996.
The Libyan news agency JANA on Wednesday said Gaddafi would lead prayers in Niger and Nigeria during a visit as leader of the Islamic Popular Leadership, an organisation he created in 1989.
